items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Louie Gallo, myself, on trumpet, and I think it was Albert George who played a drummer.

ctx.x: Who was in the Meilenburg job with Hickman? Who else?
Louie Gallo, myself, on trumpet, and I think it was Albert George who played a drummer. That was what was Forrest was.
